artworks.title: The Slave Market
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 11.3 × 20.8 cm (4 7/16 × 8 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a city scene with a wide urban landscape. There are people engaged in various activities, with some near a building on the right and others on a flight of stairs on the left. In the distance, there are buildings and structures, including a bridge over water with small boats. The line work is detailed, emphasizing architectural details and many figures. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and white. The sky is lightly illustrated with sparse lines indicating clouds.

artworks.title: Alexis Charles Henry de Tocqueville
artworks.description: The portrait depicts a man seated, with his upper half visible, down to his hips. He is facing the viewer directly with a composed expression. His facial features include a prominent nose, an angular jawline, and a slight, closed-lip smile. His hair is neatly styled, with a wave across his forehead and voluminous sides. The man is dressed in a high-collared coat with detailed buttons. The clothing is drawn with fine lines to indicate texture and layering. He is sitting on a chair with a simple design and his hands rest in his lap. The background is plain. The top left of the portrait includes the text "ASSEMBLEE NATIONALE," and below the image, his name "Alexis Charles Henry de Tocqueville" and titles are elegantly inscribed.

artworks.title: Saint James the Greater
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright. He is facing forward, holding a staff with his right hand and a string of beads with his left hand. The man has a beard and wavy hair flowing from under a large, round hat with a band. He wears a long robe that reaches his ankles, leaving his feet bare. Draped around his shoulders is a large cloak or mantle. The pattern on his clothing suggests richness in texture. The background contains floral and vine motifs on either side, framing the figure. Above him is text that reads "S. Jacob der Großer." The ground is depicted with small rocks and earth textures.

artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.description: The illustration shows a man standing with a large sword in his right hand. He has a long beard, focused expression, and long hair with a halo above his head. He is wearing a robe and holding a book in his left hand. The background features decorative elements like cherubic figures and flowing scrolls.

artworks.title: Shepherd and Shepherdess (Le Berger et la bergere)
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with sheep grazing and human figures resting nearby. Trees dominate the composition, extending upward. The horizon is obscured by a wooded area that continues into the distance. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes creating texture and volume, especially in the trees. The monochrome palette emphasizes light and shadow, adding depth to the landscape. The scene conveys a calm and timeless mood through meticulous cross-hatching.

artworks.title: The Ford (Le Gue)
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral scene with cattle grazing. A horizon can be seen with a distant shoreline across a body of water. The style is detailed etching using fine lines for textures, depth, and shadow. The color scheme is monochromatic with varying shades of brown and beige. Cattle are gathered under large trees, with a solitary figure standing nearby.

artworks.title: Un Début galant
artworks.description: The image shows two figures from about the waist up. The woman on the left has a round face with a wide smile, closed eyes, styled hair, and a striped, short-sleeved dress. The man on the right is turned towards the woman, kissing her hand. He has wide-open eyes, short, dark hair, and is wearing a dark, double-breasted coat. The background has a textured pattern of lines, handwriting above the figures, and a number at the bottom left.

artworks.title: The Road (La route)
artworks.description: This print shows a landscape depicted from a slightly elevated viewpoint. A wide path or road winds into the distance in front of us. On the left, there is a group of tall trees with thick foliage. On the right, there are a few solitary trees atop a hill. Above, the off-white sky above is mostly clear, with some few patches of light gray.

artworks.title: Woman in a Ruffled Cap (Dame agée)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within plate mark): 11.5 x 8.5 cm (4 1/2 x 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body, including the head and shoulders. The individual is positioned in a three-quarter view facing to the right. The person has delicate features with prominent cheekbones, a long straight nose, and a composed expression. Their hair is styled in soft curls framing the face, and they wear a white lace cap tied with a ribbon under the chin. The clothing visible in the portrait appears to be a light-colored garment with simple lines. The background shows a textured cross-hatched design.

artworks.title: Program for the Soiree Artistique (Programme de la Soirée des anciens élèves du Lycée de Nantes)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artistic collage featuring musical and dance elements. The drawing includes several components such as a cello and its bow, a hat, a ballerina in mid-dance, puffs of smoke rising into the sky, reflections of masts in water, and a poster advertising a 'Soirée Artistique' event. The drawing also includes motion lines and indistinct figures, contributing to the interconnected artistic and abstract feel of the piece. The overall composition has a sense of fluidity and movement, suggesting themes of music, performance, and artistic gatherings.

artworks.title: Pan and Syrinx
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures in a lush, overgrown landscape. The scene features several figures amidst dense foliage and trees, with detailed leaves and plants surrounding them. A stream flows in the foreground. The figures are engaged in dynamic interaction, with some gesturing towards a central figure holding a shepherd's staff. The artwork is rich in intricate line work, enhancing the texture of the foliage and drapery. The style is reminiscent of classical mythological themes found in art inspired by ancient stories.

artworks.title: The Little Park (Le petite parc)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a garden scene. The vegetation fills the space, creating a lush canopy. In the center, there is a small classical statue surrounded by plants and decorative elements. The fine brushstrokes and etching lines give depth and texture to the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing shades of gray and black. In the distance, there is a raised structure or terrace. The image conveys a tranquil and serene atmosphere with carefully arranged elements that invite visual exploration of the garden's space.

artworks.title: At the Black Rocks (Aux roches noires)
artworks.description: The image shows a series of fluid lines and shapes creating an abstract composition within a rectangle. In the center, the abstract forms suggest the shape of a figure sitting with their head in their hands. To the left, swirling lines resemble waves. On the right, there are more vertical curved lines akin to wood grain patterns. The overall arrangement is abstract.

artworks.title: At the Black Rocks (Aux roches noires)
artworks.description: The image shows an arrangement of flowing lines and curves outlining three human figure shapes in different positions. The central figure is seated with hands to their head, while the others are in relaxed postures. The image has a blend of solid and textured areas that resemble waves or fabric surrounding the figures.

artworks.title: Breton Women beside a Fence (Bretonnes à la barrière)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright with their back facing the viewer. The person is wearing a large hat with cloth tied under the chin, covering their head. The individual has hands on hips and is clothed in a dark top with a light cape-like collar and a patterned skirt. A fence made of uneven vertical posts surrounds them. The background shows a rural scene with hills, trees, and a winding path. The illustration is rendered in a sketch in monochromatic tones.

artworks.title: Leda (Cover)
artworks.description: The image shows a partial illustration of a person's upper body in profile. The person's head is turned slightly to the side, with delicate facial features including a small nose and prominent eyebrows. The dark hair is tied back, revealing the neck and shoulder. The person wears an abstract draped garment. Surrounding them are decorative elements like flowers, leaves, and birds with long necks. The background has a subtle texture, and there is handwritten text curving along the top edge. The composition is framed around the central figure and motifs.

artworks.title: Te Faruru (They are Making Love Here)
artworks.description: The image shows the full body of a person seated in a crouching position, with one knee raised and the other bent beneath them. Their face is mostly shrouded in dark shades, with bold lines and shadowing. The person is holding a bowl or similar object. Their hair blends into swirling lines around them. The individual wears clothing with a red accent, possibly a wrap around the lower body. In the background, there is another figure with long flowing hair outlined by intricate patterns of swirls and lines. There is text that reads "TE FARURU" and "190." The image has a textured, artistic appearance with a mix of light and dark areas, suggesting it was created on a colored surface.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Le Sourire" (Titre du Sourire)
artworks.description: This is a painting of abstract figures and floral elements. The artwork depicts several figures with minimalistic and stylized forms. The central figure is in front, with another figure behind it and one on the side with arms raised. Below these figures, there are artistic representations of flowers or floral shapes. The style is characterized by bold, black lines and patterns against a cream background.

artworks.title: Mercury and Argus (Mercure et Argus)
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with an expansive landscape, a structure resembling classical columns to the right, various trees framing the scene, two figures playing musical instruments in the middle surrounded by resting cows, hills in the background, and distant mountains under a cloudy sky. The artwork uses fine etching in a monochromatic palette of sepia shades to depict depth and texture, emphasizing warmth and an antiquated feel.

artworks.title: Study for "Swiss Sentry at the Louvre"
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a person standing in a three-quarter view. The person is wearing a top hat, a coat with wide lapels, a buttoned vest, trousers, and holding a walking stick. A medal or decorative badge is pinned on the coat. The person's head is turned slightly to the left, and the face is minimally detailed. The background appears plain with some stains on the paper.

artworks.title: Christ and the Apostles and the Holy Women
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures set against a background of landscapes and a castle. The drawing depicts robed individuals. In the background, a hilly landscape unfolds with trees and rivers, leading towards a castle with circular towers. The details capture the texture of the foliage, the robes, and the architectural elements, suggesting an atmosphere of storytelling and medieval undertones.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Lake [top plate]
artworks.medium: etching [one of 2 prints on piece of uncut paper]
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a landscape showing a medieval castle among rocky ridges. A line of hills divides the sky from the land near the horizon, where small structures are visible. Detailed lines depict jagged rocks, trees, and the castle in the foreground. A body of water with sailboats can be seen in the central part of the image. Farther away, there are architectural forms hinting at a settlement. The color palette is monochromatic, with an emphasis on light and shadow created by the etching lines.

artworks.title: Landscape with Sail Boats [bottom plate]
artworks.medium: etching [one of 2 prints on piece of uncut paper]
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape and water seen from a high viewpoint. It includes a line of hills, a small town with unique buildings, a small house on a hill, sailboats on the water, and a castle-like structure on a rocky outcrop. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic scheme using fine lines, creating a detailed and classic illustration of the elements.

artworks.title: Man and Woman
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing next to a bed. She has short, curly blonde hair and is wearing a long, loose-fitting dress with colorful spots. The woman is holding a small object in her right hand, with her hands on her hips and weight slightly shifted to one side. Beside her, a neatly made bed shows a person's head under the covers, with dark, slicked-back hair. The background displays soft, blue and peach watercolors, indicating an abstract interior space.
